_comment: Datasets and models created by the author. Availability must reflect what is actually public.

resources.name: Sudanese Arabic harmful-language corpus
resources.description: About 40,000 Sudanese Arabic sentences from Telegram and Twitter (2015–2020 and 2023–2025), labelled for binary and three-class harmful-language detection with a hybrid framework: Sudanese-specific weak-supervision rules plus large language model annotation, followed by human review of a stratified 10,000-sentence sample by three native speakers.
resources.availability: Public: record identifiers, splits and labels (texts are not redistributed)

resources.name: Sudanese Arabic app-review sentiment corpus
resources.description: 13,293 Sudanese Arabic Google Play reviews of eight banking, telecom and transport apps, labelled negative / neutral / positive, with leakage-safe grouped splits that keep near-duplicate reviews in the same partition. Built for benchmarking Arabic encoders, sector-aware models and ensembles on Sudanese sentiment.
resources.availability: Not yet publicly released — enquiries by email

resources.name: SudaBERT-v2
resources.description: A Sudanese Arabic BERT encoder initialised from the original SudaBERT (Elgezouli et al., 2021) and further pre-trained with masked language modelling on 452,410 Telegram sentences from 2023–2025, so that it covers recent and conflict-era vocabulary. Evaluated in the author's dialect-identification, sentiment and harmful-language studies.
resources.availability: Not yet publicly released — enquiries by email
